name: Bell 407
summary: Four-blade development of the LongRanger and a mainstay of US air medical, law enforcement, tour and utility operators.

wings: Four-blade soft-in-plane main rotor with a composite hub
engines: Single turbine on the roof with an exhaust stack angled up and aft
Engine cowling slightly bulkier than the 206's
fuselage: LongRanger-style stretched cabin, about 8 in. wider than the 206
Larger cabin windows than the 206 series
Skids, often with high skid gear or floats
tail: Long slim tail boom with endplate-fin horizontal stabilizer
Two-blade tail rotor on a fin with a ventral part

tellTales: Four blades on a light single-engine cabin with a JetRanger-style tail
Horizontal stabilizer with small endplate fins
Single exhaust stack on the roof

confusedWith.howToTell: The 407 has four main rotor blades and a wider cabin with bigger windows; the 206 has two blades.
The 429 is a twin with two exhausts and a larger, deeper cabin; the 407 has one engine and one exhaust.
The H125 has three main blades and a taller, rounder cabin; the 407 has four blades on a slimmer LongRanger-style cabin.
